title: Long Expiry screenshot investigated through DITO public guest catalog entry
summary: The owner supplied a screenshot of Long Expiry 599, 799 and 999. The selected 799 offer is shown as 80GB, unlimited all-network SMS, unlimited DITO calls and 1000 other-network mobile minutes for 365 days. A fresh DITO prepaid FAQ read recommends Long Expiry through GCash and describes the 599 tier as 40GB for one year. The public guest entry API returned a mobile category deep link whose root is ECARE_PROMO_PREPAID, distinct from the dashboard's ECARE_PROMO_WEB_PREPAID. No exact Long Expiry offer ID, account eligibility or purchase result is established.

evidence.description: Read-only public response returned mobile and home entry cards; mobile deep link uses ECARE_PROMO_PREPAID.
Dashboard category query uses the web prepaid root.

nextSteps: Query the returned mobile category root and traverse only returned catalog identifiers; establish whether Long Expiry is listed without assuming recipient eligibility.
